meta.title: GitHub access guide
meta.description: Sidebar panel (GitHub access guide) that repairs GitHub access on networks where some GitHub server addresses are unreachable. Start proxy runs a local racing proxy on 127.0.0.1:17897 that dials every candidate address of a host at once and keeps the first one that connects, then points the Windows system proxy, git's http.proxy and HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY at it; the previous settings are snapshotted first and restored exactly when you stop it or remove the plugin, and it needs no administrator rights and never edits hosts. Repair instead installs a reversible git url.<accelerator>.insteadOf rewrite and reports success only after verifying the plain github.com URL works. The panel also shows live channel status, converts a GitHub URL into forms this network can open, and carries the symptom table, five-minute local checks, hosts guidance, SSH-over-443 notes and command cheat sheet. Limits: it helps when individual addresses are blocked or flaky; a network that drops the whole GitHub address range cannot be repaired this way, and accelerator prefixes serve files and release archives, not github.com HTML pages.
